evidence: Filtering by API module shows only API documents; clicking All restores complete list with documents from all modules (API, AUTH, DATA, UI, CORE).
Document displays title, description, version (v1.2.0), update date (2024-01-10), content sections (WCAG Requirements, Accessibility Testing), and related documents (Component Library).

Clicking the Component Library link in expanded WCAG Requirements section navigated to Component Library document with updated title, date, version, description, content sections, and related documents.
After collapsing Component Structure section, the expanded content body (generic e584 with paragraph and links) is no longer in DOM. Section header remains clickable for reopening.
After expanding Component Structure, the content body (generic e623 with paragraph and Design Tokens link) is restored. Section is marked [active].
Graph zoom controls work with visible feedback: Zoom In/Out buttons show [active] attribute and zoom level displays changes (100% → 120% → 100%). Reset View button shows [active] attribute.

Knowledge graph displays 19 document nodes representing all available documents across all modules (API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System). Module legend shows all 5 modules with associated document nodes for each.

Application provides three views: Documents (button e15), Knowledge Graph (button e20), and Favorites (button e26). Each tab switches to its respective view with [active] attribute showing current view.

After switching from Documents → Knowledge Graph → Favorites → Documents, Component Library remains selected with Component Structure section expanded, confirming document selection and section states are preserved.

Added 2 favorites (Component Library, Design Tokens); count updates to "Favorites 2" and displays in Favorites view. Favorite markers survive: (1) tab switching (Documents→Knowledge Graph→Documents), (2) module filtering (showing "Remove from favorites" for both even after UI filter), (3) markers persisted across interactions.

Component Library document displays related documents (Design Tokens, Accessibility Standards) and does not list itself. Verified by checking related documents section which excludes Component Library.

Knowledge graph displays 19 document nodes (one for each available document) associated with their respective modules (API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System). Graph shows connections/relationships between documents through node positioning.

Content sections display img indicators (e1678, e1691, etc.). Section state indicated by [active] attribute: expanded sections show [active] with visible content body (e.g., Prop Patterns e1689 [active] with e1942 content); collapsed sections lack [active] attribute without content body visible.
Searching for "nonexistentdocument" displays: heading "No documents found" and message "Try adjusting your search or filter criteria". Clearing search restores all matching documents.

Clicked Accessibility Standards link in collapsed Prop Patterns section. Prompt appeared: "Please expand the section to access links" with dismiss button. Link button marked [active]. Current document (Component Library) remained open, proving the link wasn't followed.

Knowledge Graph view displays clickable document nodes (e688-e797). Application architecture with left-pane graph and right-pane detail panel supports opening documents from graph without tab navigation. Graph nodes remain interactive for later return to graph navigation.
